title: Lever Review (2026)
intro: Lever is evaluated here as an applicant tracking / recruiting (ATS) platform — Lever is an ATS plus recruiting CRM for growing and enterprise talent teams, now under Employ (alongside JazzHR and Jobvite). The pricing page is quote-led: a core AI-powered hiring platform (ATS+CRM, reporting, AI screening, interview transcripts/summaries, fraud signals) plus add-ons (Candidate Insights, AI Screening by VONQ, Onboarding). No published USD floor, free plan, or self-serve trial — demo / quote only. IBM watsonx.governance is marketed for AI governance. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Lever when a mid-market ATS+CRM with AI screening is the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need published SMB ATS prices or Greenhouse-depth structured hiring kits.
verdict: Choose Lever when a mid-market ATS+CRM with AI screening is the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need published SMB ATS prices or Greenhouse-depth structured hiring kits. Compare Greenhouse for structured hiring, Ashby for modern AI ATS analytics, Workable for published floors, and Breezy HR for a free Bootstrap. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: ATS+CRM in one recruiting workspace is familiar to mid-market TA. Not lab-tested.
Primary job is ATS/recruiting. Scored as a Greenhouse/Ashby peer — not WFM or HRIS.
ATS+CRM, screening, and interview intelligence are solid. Held at 8 vs Greenhouse kits and Ashby analytics depth.
HRIS, LinkedIn, and collaboration connectors are table-stakes for this cohort.
Recruiter mobility only — not deskless WFM.
Reporting plus Candidate Insights add-on is adequate mid-market TA analytics.
Quote-by-company-size supports growth; Employ portfolio is the enterprise adjacency.
Opaque custom quotes and add-ons depress value versus Workable/Breezy published floors. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI screening, transcripts/summaries, fraud signals, and watsonx.governance are a real ATS AI story with packaging gates.
